title: Approval.
officialText:
Urinals shall conform to ANSI Z124.9, ASME A112.19.2M, CSA B45.1 or CSA B45.5. Urinals shall conform to
the water consumption requirements of Section 604.4. Water-supplied urinals shall conform to the hydraulic performance require-
ments of ASME A112.19.6, CSA B45.1 or CSA B45.5.
